Produsen listrik swasta tertua (sejak 19: The oldest independent power producer (since 1993), with an integrated IUPTLU licence granting exclusive supply to industrial customers in its business area; more than 2.500 customers, 73% of them for over 10 years, churn of 0,1-0,4% a year in 2022-1H26.
Menopang volume industri yang stabil di: Supports stable industrial volumes in the model; volume growth above trend (data centres) remains an Analyst Assumption tested at ±1 pp.
Pelanggan industri 91% pendapatan 1H26 d: Industrial customers made up 91% of 1H26 revenue and PLN 9% through a 150 MW PPA expiring on 31 May 2031; data centres are 12% of industrial consumption. Gas supply is concentrated: PGN 17% and Pertamina EP 13% of 1H26 net sales; no related-party suppliers.
PLN dikeluarkan dari nilai terminal; gan: PLN is excluded from the terminal value; gas supply disruptions (as in 2025) are a volume and cost risk not modelled as recurring.
Formula tarif listrik yang disetujui Pem: The government-approved power tariff formula passes the fuel component through to customers; the PLN tariff follows PLN's gas price.
Sensitivitas biaya bahan bakar diteruska: The fuel cost sensitivity is passed through to industrial tariffs, so the net effect on value is small; realised tariffs beyond the fuel component remain an Analyst Assumption.
Konsumsi pelanggan industri datar 2022-2: Industrial customer consumption was flat in 2022-2025 (3.454, 3.309, 3.365, 3.455 GWh) and rose 7,6% yoy in 1H26; the manufacturing base (automotive, electronics, plastics, food) follows the industrial cycle.
Pertumbuhan volume diturunkan bertahap d: Volume growth is stepped down gradually and tested at ±1 pp a year.
Payout dividen 95-96% laba 2022-2025; Se: Dividend payout of 95-96% of 2022-2025 profit; US$500 juta Senior Notes repaid and US$350 juta Notes 2035 (5,65%) issued in 2025; the US$44 juta gas engine project is fully funded.
Payout 95% dan jadwal utang flat sampai: A 95% payout and a flat debt schedule to 2035 in the model; cash builds only modestly.
PT Udinda Wahanatama pemegang saham terb: PT Udinda Wahanatama is the largest shareholder at 30,48%; public holders of under 5% each 26,64%; treasury shares 1,47%.
Tidak mengubah arus kas; memengaruhi fre: No effect on cash flows; it affects the free float and share liquidity.
Pembangkit listrik gas dan uap (siklus g: Gas and steam (combined-cycle) power and industrial water for industrial customers, plus port, tank and logistics; the power model closest to POWR. P/E above 50x, so only P/B enters the median.
Produsen listrik dan uap panas bumi deng: Geothermal power and steam producer with long-term offtake contracts and stable profit.
Produsen listrik panas bumi dan angin de: Geothermal and wind power producer with long-term contracts, the same model as PGEO; P/E and P/B are far above the valuation range, so they are left out of the median.
Lima PLTA (69 MW) yang menjual listrik d: Five hydropower plants (69 MW) selling power under long-term contracts; small but profitable.
Pengembang dan operator PLTA; P/E dan P/: Hydropower developer and operator; P/E and P/B above the valuation range, so they are left out of the median.
Pembangkit minihidro dan biogas dengan p: Mini-hydro and biogas generator with revenue of Rp64 miliar; too small to compare.
Rugi; kapitalisasi di bawah Rp0,1 triliu: Loss-making; market capitalisation below Rp0,1 triliun.
